story.heading: Who we are
story.p1: Peng Global Holding is a Cameroonian company built around one job: giving international brands a dependable route into Cameroon and the CEMAC region. We represent, import, and distribute — and we take responsibility for the whole chain, from regulatory compliance to the point of sale.
story.p2: Our anchor engagement is the exclusive representation of the Turkish stationery brands PENSAN Kalem and PENSAN Kidz for Cameroon and CEMAC. Through our publishing subsidiary Peng Edition, we also develop and distribute educational works for the national school system, including two titles on Cameroon's official secondary school textbook list.

valueProp.heading: Why partners choose Cameroon — and us
valueProp.p1: Cameroon is the gateway to the CEMAC market: six countries sharing a currency, a customs framework, and growing demand for quality international products. Entering this market requires local knowledge — of regulation, of distribution, of how business is actually done.
valueProp.p2: That is what we provide. A foreign manufacturer working with Peng Global Holding gets a single accountable partner: market entry analysis, import and compliance handled correctly, and access to an established distribution network.

commitment.heading: Our commitment
commitment.text: We only claim what we can prove. Our partnerships are exclusive and documented, our books are on the official national list, and our growth is built on delivering for the partners we already have.

leadership.heading: Our Leadership Team
leadership.ceoText: Befue Charlie-Bey leads the corporate direction of Peng Global Holding and the creative vision of Peng Edition. He is a published poet, playwright, and educator who has served as principal of Collège Protestant Luc Bell in Douala.
leadership.mdText: Co-directs the operations, international trade relationships, customs compliance, and heavy machinery logistics chains across Cameroon and the CEMAC market.

author.name: Charlie-Bey
author.bio: Born in the South West Region of Cameroon, Befue Charlie-Bey studied Literature in English and Performing and Visual Arts at the University of Buea, graduating top of his class. A poet, novelist, and playwright, he has taught English language and literature at secondary and high school level. He is Creative Director and CEO of NAN MEDIA Ltd, a book publishing, film production and audiovisual content firm based in Douala, and currently serves as principal of Collège Protestant Luc Bell.

fireside.title: Fireside Tales
fireside.author: Charlie-Bey
fireside.subject: Literature in English
fireside.description: A collection of nine tales drawn from the grassfield, coastal, and forest regions of Cameroon, written in accessible English. Officially prescribed on the Cameroon secondary school textbook list.
fireside.blurb: This collection of nine tales drawn from the grassfield, coastal and forest regions of Cameroon and well-crafted in simple English is nothing less than a bag of wit and the transmission of the African experience of yore. To the African, the tale is a vessel of wisdom and everyone is bound to drink from it for morals and spiritual upliftment.
